Delhi schools and Mayor's office receive bomb threat emails

Multiple schools in Delhi and the Mayor's office received bomb threat emails on April 12. Police conducted searches at the affected locations and found no suspicious objects. The emails were reportedly sent from an external source. Authorities are investigating the origin of the threats.
